mcat_description.short: Storage Buildings are prefabricated structures — primarily Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) made from steel — designed and fabricated off-site and assembled on-site for industrial, agricultural, and logistics storage use. They are sold as turnkey construction services or as supply-and-erect packages, quoted per square foot of built-up area.
mcat_description.long: Storage Buildings in the Indian B2B market are predominantly Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) steel structures — comprising primary steel frames, columns, beams, roof panels, and wall cladding — fabricated in a factory and assembled on-site for durable, large-span storage use. The category spans warehouse sheds, godowns, cold storage structures, agricultural storage buildings, and multi-bay industrial storage units, all characterised by faster construction timelines and lower costs compared to conventional RCC construction. Buyers across manufacturing, logistics, e-commerce, agriculture, and pharmaceuticals procure these structures as customised, project-based solutions with specifications driven by span width, eave height, load capacity, insulation requirements, and seismic/wind zone compliance. Sellers typically offer end-to-end turnkey services covering design, fabrication, transportation, and erection, with IS code compliance (structural steel standards) as a baseline quality signal.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Storage Buildings' under the Prefabricated Structures taxonomy refers almost exclusively to Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — steel-framed structures with PPGI/colour-coated roofing sheets, PUF or EPS insulated sandwich panel walls, and hot-rolled or cold-formed steel primary frames. The dominant commercial form is the turnkey supply-and-erect warehouse or godown, sold as a project with custom dimensions. Leading Indian manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, ECOPlus, Pressmach, Interarch Building Products, and Kaizen Steel Building Solutions, all offering PAN-India project execution. Buyers increasingly prefer PEB over conventional RCC godowns due to 30–50% faster construction timelines and significant cost savings on labour and materials (corroborated by EPACK and ECOPlus). Key industry sectors driving demand include logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, agriculture, and pharmaceuticals. IS code compliance (structural steel welding and design codes) is a baseline quality signal cited by multiple manufacturers. The category also includes cold storage PEB structures (PUF-insulated with HVAC integration), mezzanine floor warehouses, and multi-bay godowns — all variants of the same PEB construction method. Sellers are geographically concentrated in NCR (Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Faridabad), Bengaluru, Pune, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, and Coimbatore.
